name: com.streethawk.library.ActivityRecognitionIntentService
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. When Google Play Services delivers an activity-recognition result, StreetHawk's background service maps the most likely motion, such as walking or driving, to a saved activity category. StreetHawk starts it from its location service to keep that category current.
disableEffect: StreetHawk will stop updating motion categories used in its location and activity reports.
